answer.rationale: Finance mandates 18% cost reduction and incumbent refused to reopen pricing, making renewal + negotiation infeasible. memory_c2 demonstrates the low-cost vendor pathway achieves sharp unit cost cuts with quick onboarding and reliable invoicing—directly addressing the cost mandate. However, assembly line operates at 94% capacity with no buffer, so switching carries delivery risk. Verifying memory_c2 confirms the vendor's track record before committing. memory_c3 (second sourcing) is insufficient alone to hit 18% target. Deferring loses the window entirely. The switch must execute quickly given the 14-day expiry and cannot accommodate simultaneous second-source ramp. This decision carries real downside if the vendor stumbles on volume or timing, but the mandate leaves no lower-risk path.
